blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Guidance repels the prediction of a diffusion model away from a weaker reference prediction. It substantially improves sample quality, but its mechanism remains poorly understood. We first find that, at the scales used in practice, guidance does not improve the prediction of the posterior mean (the model's training target); it makes the prediction worse, while samples improve. Second, posterior-mean predictions have less variance than the data, and we find that guidance restores it. We introduce variance-matched guidance: a closed-form rule that picks the guidance scale by matching the variance of the guided predictions to that of the data. Without tuning, it recovers the hand-picked scales of eleven widely used models across image, video, audio, motion, and world generation; to our knowledge, no previous explanation of guidance predicts them. Applied per noise level, it yields a schedule without tuned hyperparameters that users prefer to hand-crafted ones on SD 3.5 Medium. Third, we offer an interpretation of the mechanism behind guidance: each model makes a random error in predicting the posterior mean, and guidance rescales the difference of these errors into a sample with the posterior's covariance, which improves sampling. This view also suggests two new hypotheses that our experiments support: guidance can work with negative scales, and guiding a model with its own checkpoint needs a larger scale than guiding it with an independently trained model.
blocks.zh: 指导使对扩散模型的预测远离较弱的参考预测。 它大大提高了抽样质量,但其机制仍然缺乏了解。 我们首先发现,在实际使用的尺度上,指导并不能改进对后期平均值(模型的训练目标)的预测;它使得预测更糟糕,而样品则有所改善. 第二,后指的预测与数据相比差异较小,我们发现指导可以恢复. 我们采用差异相匹配的指向:一个封闭式规则,通过将所引导的预测与数据相匹配来选择指向尺度. 不调音,它恢复了由11个广泛使用的模型组成的手取尺度,这些模型跨越了图像,视频,音频,运动,以及世界代;据我们所知,之前对指南的解释没有预测它们. 应用每个噪声级别,它产生一个没有调制超参数的调度,用户更喜欢SD 3.5 Medium上的手制. 第三,我们给出了对指向背后的机制的解释:每个模型在预测后方指向时都会发生随机出错,而指向则会用后方的同分力来将这些出错的区别重新分级到样本中去,从而改进了取向. 这种观点还提出两个新的假设,即我们的实验支持:指导可以与负尺度相配合,指导一个带有自己检查站的模型需要比用独立训练的模型指导更大的尺度.

blocks.en: Diffusion [ 59 , 23 , 62 ] and flow-based [ 38 , 42 ] models generate images [ 54 , 16 ] , videos [ 24 , 9 ] , audio [ 31 , 39 ] and robot actions [ 12 , 7 ] . In practice, their sample quality hinges on guidance [ 15 , 22 ] , which combines two predictions of the clean sample from a noisy input x t x_{t} : D w ​ ( x t ) = D 0 ​ ( x t ) + w ⁡ [ D 1 ​ ( x t ) − D 0 ​ ( x t ) ] . D_{w}(x_{t})=D_{0}(x_{t})+w\bigl[D_{1}(x_{t})-D_{0}(x_{t})\bigr]. (1) In classifier-free guidance (CFG) [ 22 ] , D 1 D_{1} and D 0 D_{0} are a network’s conditional and unconditional predictions; in autoguidance [ 28 ] , D 0 D_{0} is a smaller or less-trained version of D 1 D_{1} . While w = 1 w=1 recovers D 1 D_{1} , practitioners hand-pick far larger scales, such as w = 7.5 w=7.5 for Stable Diffusion (SD) 1.5 [ 54 ] .

(1)在无分级制导(CFG)[22],D 1 D_{1}和D0 D_{0}是网络的有条件和无条件的预测;在自动制导[28],D0 D_{0}是D1 D_{1}的少或少训练版本. 虽然w=1 w=1 recovers D 1 D_{1},但从业者手挑大得多的鳞片,如w=7.5 w=7.5 稳定扩散(SD)1.5 [54].

blocks.en:
Today, we lack a model that explains the effectiveness of guidance, let alone one that predicts the effective guidance scale w w . CFG is commonly understood as sampling from a sharpened conditional distribution, but this interpretation does not seem to hold in practice [ 10 , 46 ] , and it does not explain why autoguidance [ 28 ] is effective. Karras et al. [28] propose that guidance corrects errors : the weak model makes the same errors as the strong one, only larger, so extrapolating away cancels them.
However, we find that guidance scales used in practice increase the denoising error, and are well above those predicted by an error-reduction objective.
blocks.zh:
今天,我们缺乏一个能够解释指导有效性的模式,更不用说预测有效指导尺度ww的模型。 CFG通常被理解为从更尖锐的有条件分布中取样,但这一解释似乎在实务中并不坚持[10,46],也没有解释为什么自动指导[28]是有效的. 卡尔拉斯等人. [28] 建议指导纠正以下错误: 弱的模型与强的模型产生相同的错误,只有更大的,所以推算的取消.
然而,我们发现,实际使用的指导尺度增加了去名错误,远远高于减少错误目标的预测。

blocks.en: We instead start from a simple fact: posterior-mean predictions have less variance than the data ( Sec. 5.1 ), and we find that guidance restores it. Matching the variance of the guided prediction to that of the data gives a closed-form scale, estimated from two models’ predictions on a few noised data examples. We call this rule variance-matched guidance . Without tuning, it recovers the hand-picked scales of eleven models across image, video, audio, motion, and world generation ( Guidance as Variance Matching ), for example w = 7.44 w=7.44 against the published 7.5 7.5 for SD 1.5. To our knowledge, no previous explanation of guidance predicts these scales. Unlike a metric sweep, whose optimum strongly depends on the metric and feature space ( Fig. 5 ), our rule is metric-agnostic, and in an informal user study, raters prefer its samples to those at the FID- and FD DINOv2 \mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{DINOv2}} -optimal scales ( Guidance as Variance Matching , Sec. 6.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们从一个简单的事实开始:事后的预测与数据(第5.1节)相比差异较小,我们发现指导可以恢复它。 将指导性预测与数据差异相匹配,可得出一个封闭式尺度,根据两个模型对几个新数据实例的预测进行估计。 我们称之为这个规则 差异匹配的指导。 不调音,它回收了11个模型的手工选取的尺度,这些模型跨越图像,视频,音频,运动和世界代(指导作为差异匹配),例如w=7.44 w=7.44,而SD 1.5的公布为7.5 7.5. 据我们所知,以前没有对这些指导作任何解释来预测这些尺度。 与量子扫描不同,它的最佳效果在很大程度上取决于量子和特征空间(图5),我们的规则是量子-不可知的,在非正式的用户研究中,测算者更喜欢其样本,而不是FID-和FD DINov2\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{DINOv2}最佳尺度的样本。 (作为差异匹配的指导,第6.1节)。

blocks.en: We then offer an interpretation of why this works. A sampler that at every DDIM step [ 60 ] moves toward a sample of a Gaussian approximation of the posterior p ⁡ ( x 0 | x t ) p(x_{0}|x_{t}) , instead of its mean , needs far fewer steps than DDIM when its moments are exact [ 57 , 4 ] . Surprisingly, two trained models can provide such a sample. A diffusion model is trained to predict the posterior mean but, because training is stochastic, never recovers it exactly. If we retrain a model with different seeds and training samples, each run predicts the mean with a small, random error, and we observe ( Fig. 1 ) and explain with a simple model that these errors scatter in a scaled-down copy of the posterior covariance ( Fig. 1 b). A weaker model, such as the smaller network of autoguidance or the unconditional branch of CFG, scatters more widely in the same shape. Given two such models, a linear combination that keeps the mean can scale this scatter up to the full posterior covariance ( Fig. 1 c,d). That linear combination is the guidance formula of Eq. 1 . In this view, guidance turns two estimates of the posterior mean into one prediction that carries the posterior’s mean and covariance.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们解释为什么这样做。 在DDIM的每一个步骤[60]向一个高斯近似p (x0 x t)p((x_{0}|x}|x_{t})的样板移动,而不是它的平均值,当其时刻准确[57,4]时,需要比DDIM少得多的步骤. 令人惊讶的是,两个训练有素的模型可以提供这样的样本. 一种传播模型被训练来预测后期的意思,但是,由于训练有条理,从不确切恢复. 如果我们重新训练一个具有不同种子和训练样本的模型,每个模型都会用一个小的,随机的错误来预测平均值,我们观察到(图1),用一个简单的模型来解释这些错误散落在一个缩放的后部共变(图1b)副本中. 一个较弱的模型,如较小的自动导线网络或CFG的无条件分支,会以同样形状广泛分布. 鉴于有两种模式,保持平均值的线性组合可以将这种散射扩大到完整的后共变(图1 c,d)。 线性组合是Eq. 1 的指导公式。 在这种观点中,指导将后期的两个估计平均值转化为一个带有后期的平均值和共性预测.

blocks.en: Our interpretation also makes two new predictions, which our experiments support. First, the matching condition is quadratic in w w , implying that guidance should be possible in both directions. Indeed, guiding SD 1.5 and CommonCanvas [ 19 ] , in either direction, improves FID and FD DINOv2 \mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{DINOv2}} , while every scale in between is worse than either model ( Guidance as Variance Matching ). Second, an earlier checkpoint of the strong model shares part of its training noise, so it needs a larger scale than an independently trained model ( Guidance as Variance Matching ). Our interpretation also explains two known phenomena: CFG reduces the diversity of the distribution and hurts at high noise levels.
blocks.zh: 我们的解释还提出了两项新的预测,我们的实验支持这些预测。 首先,比对条件在w w 中为四进制,意味着指导应该是双向的. 事实上,指导SD 1.5和CommonCanvas[19],无论是朝哪个方向,都改进了FID和FD DINov2\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{DINOv2},而介于两者之间的每个尺度都比两个模型都差(指导作为差异匹配)。 第二,一个较早期的强模型检查点分享其训练噪音的一部分,因此它需要比独立训练的模型(指导作为差异匹配)更大的规模. 我们的解释也解释了两个已知的现象:CFG减少分布的多样性,并在高噪声水平下伤害.

blocks.en: In summary, we: • Derive variance-matched guidance, a closed-form, metric-agnostic rule for the guidance scale. • Recover the published guidance scales of eleven models across image, video, audio, motion, and world generation. Applied per noise level, it gives a schedule without tuned hyperparameters that raters prefer to hand-crafted ones. • Reinterpret guidance: trained denoisers miss the posterior mean by errors shaped like a scaled-down posterior covariance, and guidance scales the difference between two of them up to one prediction with the posterior’s mean and covariance. • Test two hypotheses that follow from our interpretation: guidance can work with negative scales, and guiding a model with its earlier checkpoint needs a larger scale than with a retrained model.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们: 衍生差异比对制导,是制导比额表的封闭式、计量不可知规则。 • 支助 恢复已公布的十一个模型的制导尺度,包括图像、视频、音频、运动和世界一代。 每个噪声级别都应用,它给出一个没有调制超参数的表,而评估者更喜欢手工制作的. · 重新解释指导:受过训练的德诺瓦人怀念后期的意指,因为错误的形状像缩小后期的共性,而指导尺度则是其中两个人之间的差别,直到一个预言与后期的均性和共性。 从我们的解释中测试两个假设:指导可以与负尺度配合,指导一个模型与其较早的检查站需要比再训练模型更大的尺度.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Classifier-free guidance (CFG) improves generation by extrapolating conditional predictions away from unconditional ones [ 22 ] . The common explanation in the literature is amplification of the conditioning signal where extrapolating away from the unconditional prediction strengthens the condition and is read as sampling from a sharpened distribution p w ​ ( x | c ) ∝ p ​ ( x | c ) w ​ p ​ ( x ) 1 − w p_{w}(x|c)\propto p(x|c)^{w}p(x)^{1-w} [ 15 , 22 ] ; related explanations include a predictor–corrector view [ 10 ] , increased conditional confidence [ 70 ] , and amplification of condition-specific features [ 35 ] .
This distributional interpretation does not seem to hold in practice: CFG does not sample from the sharpened distribution [ 10 ] , and the guided score is not the score of any noised distribution [ 46 ] . Conditioning is also not necessary: autoguidance [ 28 ] and perturbation guidance [ 2 ] extrapolate away from weaker or degraded predictions, and a learned corrector rivals autoguidance in unconditional generation, where there is no condition to amplify [ 3 ] . These observations motivate the second explanation, due to Karras et al. [28] : a weaker version of a model makes the same systematic errors as the stronger one, only larger, so extrapolation cancels them. This shared-error view [ 1 ] extends to CFG by noting that the unconditional branch receives less training and never sees the condition ( Sec. 4 ). We examine the mismatch between MSE-optimal and generation-improving scales and propose variance restoration instead.
blocks.zh:
无级数制导(CFG)通过推导条件预测远离无条件的预测来改进生成[22]. 文献中常见的解释是放大条件信号,从无条件预测中推算出的条件信号强化了条件,并被解读为从更锐化的分布p w (x | c) ∝ p (x | c)  w w (x _{ w) 1 } w} w}w) (x | c)\propto p (x| c) ^{ w} p( (x) ^{ 1-w) ; 相关解释包括一个预测 - 校正视图 [10], 增强有条件的置信 [70], 并放大特定条件的特征 [35].
这种分布式解释在实际中似乎并不坚持:CFG不从锐化分布[10]中抽取样本,而导引分数并不是任何点名分布的分数[46]. 附加条件也没有必要:自动指导[28]和扰动指导[2]从较弱或退化的预测中推断出来,在没有条件扩大条件的无条件一代中,一个有学识的校正者会自动指导[3]. 由于Karras等人的缘故,这些意见促使作出第二个解释。 [28]:一个型号较弱的版本会做出与较强的一样的系统错误,只有更大的,所以推算可以取消. 这种共享-error view [1] 延伸至CFG,指出无条件分支接受的训练较少,从未看到条件(sec.4 ). 我们审查MSE-优化尺度与一代改进尺度之间的不匹配情况,并提议以差异还原。

blocks.en: Guidance typically uses a constant scale selected through generation-metric sweeps or human evaluation, although different quality metrics can favor different weights. Prior work has explored time-dependent schedules [ 69 ] and interval guidance, which concentrates guidance in selected noise ranges [ 33 ] . Other approaches learn or optimize guidance scales through distributional objectives, control formulations, or online evaluator feedback [ 18 , 5 , 51 , 11 ] . CFG-Rescale [ 36 ] rescales each guided prediction to the standard deviation of the conditional one, and ReCFG [ 71 ] computes coefficients from data to correct the mean, and APG [ 55 ] and CFG++ [ 13 ] reduce oversaturation and off-manifold drift; all still need a hand-picked w w . In contrast, our training-free, metric-independent variance-matched criterion calibrates a constant scale and a noise-dependent schedule directly from noised data and existing model predictions, without generation sweeps, hand-designed intervals, or additional training.
blocks.zh: 指导一般使用通过生成量度扫描或人类评价选择的恒定尺度,尽管不同的质量度量度可以偏向不同的权重. 先前的工作探索了取决于时间的时间表[69]和间隔指导,这些指导集中在选定的噪音范围[33]。 其他方法通过分布目标、控制配方或在线评估反馈[18、5、51、11]学习或优化指导尺度。 CFG-调整比例 [36] 将每个导引预测重新调整到条件之一的标准偏差,ReCFG [71] 从数据计算系数以校正平均值,而APG [55] 和CFG++ [13] 则减少过度饱和和和离磁漂移;所有都仍然需要手选的ww . 与此相对照,我们的无培训、独立度量差异标准直接通过噪声数据和现有模型预测,不进行一代扫描、手工设计间隔或额外培训,校准一个恒定尺度和以噪声为依归的时间表。

blocks.en: Several samplers go beyond the posterior mean. Bao et al. [6] learn the reverse covariance when the mean is imperfect, and distributional diffusion models learn the full posterior instead of its mean [ 14 ] . Two recent works obtain the posterior covariance from the denoiser itself through Tweedie’s formula: Schioppa and Salimans [57] add noise shaped by it to the DDIM step and improve few-step sampling, and Akhtar et al. [4] prove that matching it reduces the path-space KL divergence of DDPM from Ω ⁡ ( 1 / K ) \Omega(1/K) to O ⁡ ( 1 / K 2 ) O(1/K^{2}) in the number of steps K K and sample from it with Lanczos iterations. Both need Jacobian-vector products of the denoiser at every step, one in Schioppa and Salimans [57] and several in Akhtar et al. [4] . In our interpretation, guidance obtains a perturbation with the posterior’s covariance from a second forward pass that guided models already compute.

blocks.en: 4 Revisiting Prior Explanations of Guidance
blocks.zh: 4 重新审议先前对指导的解释

blocks.en: Before building our model of guidance in Sec. 5 , we test two common explanations of guidance from prior work and find that neither fully matches the empirical evidence.
blocks.zh: 在建立第5节中的指导模式之前,我们测试了对先前工作的指导的两种共同解释,发现两者都不完全符合经验证据。

blocks.en:
We find that much of the effectiveness of CFG may come from an autoguidance-like strong-versus-weak effect rather than from amplifying the conditioning, following the arguments of Karras et al. [28] and Kynkäänniemi et al. [33] . The unconditional branch of CFG receives only a fraction of the training signal and is the worse fit to the data [ 28 ] , and CFG helps only in a middle range of noise levels [ 33 ] , where the conditional and unconditional velocities of SD 3.5 nearly coincide (Appendix C.2 ). Figure 2 separates the two effects on ImageNet: we train EDM2-XS with label dropout, use EDM2-XL as a proxy for the posterior mean, and ask what part of the CFG difference Δ ⁡ ( x t ) = D ⁡ ( x t , c ) − D ⁡ ( x t ) \Delta(x_{t})=D(x_{t},c)-D(x_{t}) is label information and what part is approximation error. Above σ ≈ 5 \sigma\approx 5 , ‖ Δ ⁡ ( x t ) ‖ 2 \|\Delta(x_{t})\|^{2} is fifteen times the model’s own error, almost all of it is label information, and guidance there worsens FID (red). Below σ ≈ 3 \sigma\approx 3 , Δ ⁡ ( x t ) \Delta(x_{t}) falls under the model’s own error, its seed-dependent share grows from 17 % 17\% to 42 % 42\% , and guidance improves FID by 4 4 – 10 % 10\% (green).
Where guidance helps, the difference in prediction quality thus seems to dominate the difference in the prediction target caused by conditioning.
While both effects contribute to guidance, the experiments of Sec. 6 suggest that our model, built purely on the difference in prediction quality, also works for CFG.

One might then expect guidance to improve the prediction itself, so that a guided prediction reaches a lower value of the training objective ( 3 ) than the primary model alone. We find the opposite in practice. Figure 3 c evaluates this objective for SD 3.5 Medium: the published scale raises it above that of the conditional model alone at every sampling step, by up to 4 × 4\times .
Conversely, the scale that minimizes the diffusion training objective ( 3 ) for each noise level t t , w MSE ⋆ ( t ) = arg ​ min w 𝔼 x 0 , ε ∥ D w ( x 0 + σ t ε ) − x 0 ∥ 2 , w_{\mathrm{MSE}}^{\star}(t)=\argmin_{w}\mathop{\mathbb{E}}_{x_{0},\varepsilon}\bigl\|D_{w}(x_{0}+\sigma_{t}\varepsilon)-x_{0}\bigr\|^{2}, (8) which we call the MSE-optimal scale , satisfies w MSE ⋆ ≤ 1 w_{\mathrm{MSE}}^{\star}\leq 1 for most of the tested models and guidance methods ( Fig. 3 a,b).
This is at odds with the scales w ≫ 1 w\gg 1 used in practice (details in Appendices A.6 and C.1 ).

We therefore interpret guidance through the whole sampling process instead of a single prediction step.

blocks.en: 5 Guidance as Variance Matching
blocks.zh: 5 指导作为差异匹配

blocks.en: This section proposes that guidance edits the steps of DDIM to resemble those of a sampler that also captures the posterior covariance rather than the posterior mean only.
blocks.zh: 本节建议,指南编辑DDIM的步骤,使之与采集者的步骤相似,后者也捕捉后共性,而不是仅指后性。

blocks.en: 5.1 Covariance-based generation
blocks.zh: 5.1 基于共变的生成

blocks.en:
At each step, a diffusion sampler starts from a noisy input x t x_{t} and moves toward the denoiser’s prediction of the clean sample. Ideally, the denoiser returns the posterior mean, 𝔼 ⁡ [ x 0 ∣ x t ] \mathbb{E}[x_{0}\mid x_{t}] [ 27 ] .
With this prediction, DDIM recovers the data distribution in the limit of infinitely many Euler steps, but practical samplers take a finite number of steps and use imperfect denoisers.
This procedure discards the uncertainty about which clean sample produced x t x_{t} .
Moreover, since Cov ⁡ ( 𝔼 ⁡ [ x 0 | x t ] ) = Cov ⁡ ( x 0 ) − 𝔼 ⁡ [ Cov ⁡ ( x 0 | x t ) ] ⪯ Cov ⁡ ( x 0 ) , \Cov(\mathbb{E}[x_{0}|x_{t}])=\Cov(x_{0})-\mathbb{E}[\Cov(x_{0}|x_{t})]\preceq\Cov(x_{0}), the marginal distribution of single-step posterior-mean predictions has less variance than the data.

On the other extreme, we could make a modification to the DDIM step ( 7 ) by moving toward a random sample from the posterior x ^ 0 ∼ p ⁡ ( x 0 | x t ) \hat{x}_{0}\sim p(x_{0}|x_{t}) , instead of just its mean: x t ′ = σ t ′ σ t ​ x t + ( 1 − σ t ′ σ t ) ​ x ^ 0 , x ^ 0 ∼ p ⁡ ( x 0 ∣ x t ) . x_{t^{\prime}}=\frac{\sigma_{t^{\prime}}}{\sigma_{t}}x_{t}+\left(1-\frac{\sigma_{t^{\prime}}}{\sigma_{t}}\right)\hat{x}_{0},\qquad\hat{x}_{0}\sim p(x_{0}\mid x_{t}). (9) While DDIM requires solving an ODE to sample from p data p_{\mathrm{data}} , predictions of ( 9 ) over x t ∼ p t x_{t}\sim p_{t} will match p data p_{\mathrm{data}} exactly in just a single step. This new sampler is unrealistic: it requires sampling from the data distribution itself to advance to t ′ t^{\prime} . Hence, we consider a compromise that samples from a Gaussian approximation of p ⁡ ( x 0 | x t ) p(x_{0}|x_{t}) in each step: x ~ 0 = 𝔼 ⁡ [ x 0 ∣ x t ] + Cov ⁡ ( x 0 ∣ x t ) 1 / 2 ​ ε , ε ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) , \widetilde{x}_{0}=\mathbb{E}[x_{0}\mid x_{t}]+\Cov(x_{0}\mid x_{t})^{1/2}\varepsilon,\quad\varepsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I), (10) Unlike DDPM [ 23 ] , which injects isotropic Gaussian noise, this sampler injects noise shaped by the posterior covariance Cov ⁡ ( x 0 ∣ x t ) \Cov(x_{0}\mid x_{t}) , like the covariance-aware DDIM sampler of Schioppa and Salimans [57] , which improves few-step sampling. In Fig. 4 , this mean + covariance sampler needs far fewer steps K K than the mean sampler, i.e., DDIM ( Eq. 7 ).
For DDPM, matching the full posterior covariance reduces the path-space KL divergence from Ω ⁡ ( 1 / K ) \Omega(1/K) to O ⁡ ( 1 / K 2 ) O(1/K^{2}) [ 4 ] . In Appendix A.1 , we prove the analogous bounds for the DDIM step: with exact posterior moments and smooth data, the error of Eq. 10 is bounded by O ⁡ ( K − 2 ) O(K^{-2}) and that of DDIM by O ⁡ ( K − 1 ) O(K^{-1}) .

blocks.en: While estimating the high-dimensional Cov ⁡ ( x 0 | x t ) \Cov(x_{0}|x_{t}) is difficult, previous work has demonstrated the benefits of modeling posterior covariance when the mean is imperfect [ 6 ] , as well as learning the full posterior rather than its mean alone [ 14 ] . Crucially, the added variability should follow the posterior covariance; the right variance with the wrong shape does not help. On SD 3.5 Medium, adding Gaussian noise that restores the missing variance but ignores x t x_{t} , isotropic or proportional to the data covariance Cov ⁡ ( x 0 ) \Cov(x_{0}) , worsens every metric relative to adding none (Appendix D.4 ).
blocks.zh: 虽然估算高维的Cov ⁡(x 0 | x t)\Cov(x _{0}| x_{ t)是困难的,但之前的作品已经证明了当平均值不完美时,建模后共变的好处[6],以及学习完整的后变,而不是仅仅学习它的平均值[14]. 关键是,增加的可变性应该跟随后人共变;与错误形状的正确差异没有帮助. 在SD 3.5 Medium上,加入高斯噪声,恢复缺失的差数,但忽略x t x_{t},异构或与数据共变的Cov →(x 0)\Cov(x_{0}),使每个公尺的比值都恶化到无(附录D.4).

blocks.en: We now show that guidance approximates such a sampler: it combines two estimates of the posterior mean into one prediction with the posterior’s mean and covariance. We characterize a network’s errors by their distribution over retrainings, which we first show empirically.

blocks.en: In large-scale training, a finite number of training steps exposes a network to only a finite number of samples near any x t x_{t} . To control this sample count directly in a low-dimensional setting, Fig. 1 varies the training-set size N N across 1,024 1{,}024 networks trained on a mixture of Gaussians with different seeds. Across N N , their predictions at a fixed x t x_{t} spread along the posterior’s axis, in a scaled-down copy of its covariance that shrinks as 1 / N 1/N , just like the exact posterior mean of N N points ( Fig. 1 b,e). We assume that D 0 D_{0} and D 1 D_{1} are independent of each other and make independent errors at distant inputs, since a network’s error at x t x_{t} depends on the targets it saw near x t x_{t} . Averaging over inputs then stands in for averaging over retrainings. We also assume that m 0 , m 1 m_{0},m_{1} vary little across x t x_{t} at a given t t , and revisit these assumptions in Sec. 7 .

blocks.en: This section evaluates our rule for the guidance scale ( Eqs. 21 and 19 ). We demonstrate that variance-matched guidance (VMG) (1) matches the published guidance scales across models, (2) is preferred by humans in an informal user study, and (3) performs well across metrics.
blocks.zh: 本节评价我们关于指导比额表的规则(21和19)。 我们表明,差异比对指导(VMG)(1) 与公布的模型指导尺度相匹配,(2) 人类在非正式用户研究中偏好,(3) 跨度量衡表现良好。

blocks.en: We evaluate eleven pretrained CFG models across five modalities: text-to-image (SD 1.5 [ 54 ] , SD 3.5 Medium and Large [ 16 ] , FLUX.2 [klein] 4B [ 8 ] ), video (SVD [ 9 ] , Wan2.1 [ 68 ] , CogVideoX-2B [ 72 ] ), a video world model (Cosmos-Predict2.5 [ 50 ] ), audio (AudioLDM 2 [ 40 ] , Stable Audio Open [ 17 ] ) and motion (MDM [ 65 ] ). Each model keeps its released sampler and step count; compared settings share conditioning and initial noise. Scales are fitted from forward-noised calibration data, disjoint from the evaluation data, without sampling (Appendices B.1 and D.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价了11个经过预先培训的CFG模型,涉及5种模式:文本对图像(SD 1.5 [54],SD 3.5 中和大型[16],FLUX.2 [克林]4B [8],视频(SVD [9],Wan2.1 [68],CogVideoX-2B [72]),视频世界模型(宇宙-预测2.5 [50]),音频(AudioLDM 2 [40],Stable Audio Open [17])和动作(MDM [65])。 每个模型都保留其发布的采样器和步数;比较设置共享条件和初始噪声. 标尺是根据前哨校准数据安装的,与评价数据脱节,不作取样(附录B.1和D.3)。

blocks.en:
The main challenge of evaluating guidance scales is that different metrics lead to different optima.
We use each modality’s distribution distance, precision, recall and alignment score (Appendix B.1 ).
In Fig. 5 , the best constant for SD 3.5 Medium ranges from w = 1 w=1 for recall [ 32 ] in Inception-v3 features [ 64 ] to 11.5 11.5 for CLIP.
blocks.zh:
评价指导尺度的主要挑战是,不同的衡量标准会导致不同的选择。
我们使用每种模式的分布距离、精度、回忆和对齐分数(附录B.1)。
以法义. 5,SD 3.5的最好常数介于Inception-v3特征中的w=1 w=1的召回[32]到CLIP的11.5 11.5.

blocks.en: 6.1 Results
blocks.zh: 6.1 结果

blocks.en:
Most models come with a published scale.
How it was chosen is rarely documented, and Fig. 5 and Tab. 2 show that it matches no metric’s optimum (Appendix C.5 ).
We hypothesize that, in practice, published guidance scales are mostly picked by human judgment.
In Guidance as Variance Matching , our constant predicts the published scales across image, video, audio, motion and world models, without any sampling: on SD 3.5 Medium the fit costs less than generating the evaluation set once, and far less than the sweep behind Fig. 5 (Appendix B.1 ). It also needs few examples: the scale’s standard deviation is 0.06 0.06 from 256 256 photos on SD 3.5 Medium (Appendix D.3 ).

blocks.en: A line of work replaces the constant scale with a hand-designed function of the noise level, and other methods learn the schedule with extra training or evaluator feedback [ 18 , 5 , 51 ] . Among the hand-designed schedules, interval guidance [ 33 ] guides only within a range of noise levels, the linear schedule of Wang et al. [69] raises the weight linearly over sampling, and TV-CFG [ 25 ] raises it toward the middle of sampling and lowers it again. Each needs a base weight w w , and interval guidance also the interval, whereas our schedule has none to tune. On SD 3.5 Medium, our schedule is preferred to all three in the user study ( Tab. 1 ). In Tab. 4 , we compare them on the metrics: out of the box, our schedule gives the best DINOv2 precision and CLIP score of all settings, while interval and linear guidance reach lower FID, FD DINOv2 and recall. Its higher mean scale ( 7.82 7.82 ) may account for part of this gain. Setting their base weight to our constant instead of the published one lowers the FID of all three, so our weight is also search-free for them.

blocks.en: 7 What Variance Matching Predicts

blocks.en: Our interpretation makes predictions that, to our knowledge, no other explanation of guidance makes. We test two of them and use the same lens on two known effects.

blocks.en: The matching condition is quadratic in w w ( Eq. 19 ), and its two roots often have opposite signs: the positive root extrapolates the strong model away from the weak one, the negative root extrapolates the weak model away from the strong one and restores the same covariance. Error correction would suggest a gain in one direction only, away from the model that makes the larger error. We test this with two text-to-image models that share the latent space of SD 1.5 but were trained on different data: SD 1.5 itself [ 54 ] and CommonCanvas [ 19 ] , trained on Creative-Commons images. With D 0 D_{0} the CommonCanvas prediction and D 1 D_{1} the SD 1.5 prediction in Eq. 1 , w > 1 w>1 guides SD 1.5 away from CommonCanvas and w < 0 w<0 guides CommonCanvas away from SD 1.5. In Guidance as Variance Matching , both directions improve both metrics, while every 0 < w < 1 0<w<1 is worse than either model. The two models were trained on different data, so there is no condition to amplify, and a gain in both directions is hard to reconcile with error correction alone. Two more pairs, SD 2.1 with SD 1.5 and with CommonCanvas, behave the same way (Appendix C.4 ). Not every pair does, and what separates those that do is left to future work.

blocks.en: Our interpretation in Sec. 5.2 assumes that the two models are trained on independent data, but in autoguidance the weak model is often an earlier checkpoint of the strong one. The strong model has then seen all N 0 N_{0} samples of the weak one and N 1 − N 0 N_{1}-N_{0} new ones. In our simplified model of training, the m 0 ​ ( x t ) m_{0}(x_{t}) samples that the weak model averages are thus also averaged by the strong one, and their errors cancel in the difference Δ = D 1 − D 0 \Delta=D_{1}-D_{0} that guidance amplifies. The difference thus has a smaller variance than with an independent model (Appendix A.4 ): Cov ⁡ ( Δ cp ) = ( 1 m 0 − 1 m 1 ) ​ Σ ≺ ( 1 m 0 + 1 m 1 ) ​ Σ = Cov ⁡ ( Δ id ) \Cov(\Delta_{\mathrm{cp}})\!=\!\bigl(\tfrac{1}{m_{0}}\!-\!\tfrac{1}{m_{1}}\bigr)\Sigma\!\prec\!\bigl(\tfrac{1}{m_{0}}\!+\!\tfrac{1}{m_{1}}\bigr)\Sigma\!=\!\Cov(\Delta_{\mathrm{id}}) (22) for a checkpoint and an independent model, where Σ = Cov ⁡ ( x 0 | x t ) \Sigma=\Cov(x_{0}|x_{t}) . Guidance must therefore stretch the difference further: w ⋆ ≈ ( 1 / m 0 ∓ 1 / m 1 ) − 1 / 2 w^{\star}\approx(1/m_{0}\mp 1/m_{1})^{-1/2} for large m 0 , m 1 m_{0},m_{1} . We test this with two EDM2-XS runs on ImageNet-64 that differ only in their seed, taking the weak model from the strong model’s own run or from the other run at the same step. The checkpoint indeed needs the larger FID- and FD DINOv2 -optimal scale ( Guidance as Variance Matching ), but only once it has at least half of the strong model’s training, and by less than Eq. 22 implies. The gap shows how training forgets: our model averages all samples alike, but SGD moves the weights toward each new batch, so an early checkpoint shares little with the final model. An exponential moving average over batches with one fitted memory length reproduces the measured ratios ( Guidance as Variance Matching , Appendix A.5 ).

blocks.en: Reduced sample diversity is a well-known side effect of guidance [ 22 , 33 ] . Section 5 treats the models’ errors at different x t x_{t} as independent, so that each trajectory draws its own sample of the posterior. For nearby x t x_{t} , however, the errors are correlated: a fixed pair of trained models defines a smooth error function of ( x t , σ ) (x_{t},\sigma) [ 53 ] (we measure these correlations for EDM2 in Appendix C.3 ). Without guidance the predictions stay close to the posterior mean, and a small perturbation of x t x_{t} can tip a trajectory into another mode. In our view, guidance amplifies this shared error and pushes every trajectory in a neighborhood toward the same point of the posterior rather than independent draws, so all of them commit to one mode. To illustrate this effect, we modify the exact mean + covariance sampler ( Eq. 10 ) by replacing its independent noise ε \varepsilon with a single fixed random field g ⁡ ( x t , σ ) g(x_{t},\sigma) shared by all trajectories. At each ( x t , σ ) (x_{t},\sigma) , the field is still standard Gaussian, so the local posterior covariance is unchanged, but nearby inputs (within distance ℓ x \ell_{x} ) and noise levels (within ℓ t \ell_{t} in log ⁡ σ \log\sigma ) receive correlated perturbations, with ℓ x = ℓ t = 0 \ell_{x}=\ell_{t}=0 recovering independent noise. On the ten-Gaussian mixture of Fig. 1 , increasing ℓ x \ell_{x} and ℓ t \ell_{t} concentrates samples onto fewer modes while keeping them on the true clusters ( Fig. 6 , top), matching the effect of increasing the guidance scale w w with a trained pair ( Fig. 6 , bottom). Appendix C.3 defines g ⁡ ( x t , σ ) g(x_{t},\sigma) formally and shows the same trade-off on ImageNet- 64 64 .

blocks.en: CFG is known to harm generation at high noise levels [ 33 ] , which Karras et al. [28] attribute to the conditional and unconditional denoisers targeting different distributions. Our interpretation gives this a geometric form: guidance restores the posterior covariance only if the two prediction covariances are aligned with it. In CFG at high noise, the principal directions of the conditional and unconditional predictions are substantially misaligned, whereas in the interval where CFG helps they agree (Appendix C.2 ). Under autoguidance both models target the same distribution, and their prediction covariances stay aligned throughout (Appendix C.2 ). Our mechanism thus breaks down where CFG is observed to hurt.
blocks.zh: CFG已知在高噪量下危害生成[33], Karras等人. [28] 属性于针对不同分布的有条件和无条件的除鼠者. 我们的解释赋予了这个几何形式:只有两种预测的共性与之一致时,指导才能恢复后共性. 在高噪声的CFG中,有条件和无条件预测的主要方向大错特错,而在CFG帮助他们达成一致的间隔期(附录C.2.). 在自动指导下,两种模型都针对相同的分布,其预测共性始终一致(附录C.2 )。 因此,我们的机制在发现CFG会受到伤害的地方崩溃。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: At the scales used in practice, guidance moves a model’s prediction away from the posterior mean, yet the samples improve ( Sec. 4 ). Matching the variance of the guided prediction to that of the data gives variance-matched guidance, a closed-form, metric-free rule: its constant recovers the published scales of image, video, audio, motion and world models, and its schedule is competitive with published and hand-designed guidance without tuning ( Sec. 6 ). To explain why, we proposed that the difference between a strong and a weak model follows the posterior covariance, so that guidance turns two posterior-mean predictions into one with the posterior’s mean and covariance ( Sec. 5 ). This view also predicts that guidance works in both directions for some pairs and that a checkpoint needs a larger scale than a retrained model, which our experiments support ( Sec. 7 ).
blocks.zh: 在实际使用的尺度上,制导将模型的预测从后期的平均值移走,但样本有所改善(第4节)。 将制导预测的差异与数据的差异相匹配,给出了差异匹配的指引,一个封闭式的,无计量的规则:其恒定恢复了已公布的图像,视频,音频,运动和世界模型的尺度,其时间表与已公布和手工设计的指引具有竞争力而无需调谐(第6节). 为了解释原因,我们提议,强弱模型之间的区别应跟随后人共变,让导引将两个后人预言变为一个后人平均和共变(第5节). 这种观点还预测,制导对某些对子双向有效,一个检查站需要比我们实验支持的再训练模型更大的尺度(sec.7.

blocks.en: While our rule recovers the guidance scales used in practice, our model of CFG covers only the prediction errors of its two branches, not the conditioning information that separates them ( Sec. 4 ). Conditioning may add effects that this view misses, such as a push toward prompt alignment, which would explain why only the positive root works for CFG.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的规则恢复了实际使用的指导尺度,但我们的CFG模型只涵盖其两个分支的预测错误,而不是将它们分开的条件信息(sec.4. 附加条件可能会增加这种观点所忽略的影响,例如推动迅速对齐,这将解释为什么只有正根才对CFG起作用。

blocks.en: We used LLM-based assistants during this work. Claude (Anthropic), through Claude Code, helped draft and edit the text, check grammar, typeset L a T e X , and write and debug analysis and plotting code; OpenAI Codex was used to refine the layout of some figures. Claude was also run as an additional rater in the user study, reported separately from the human votes (Appendix E.2 ). All ideas, derivations, experiments, and claims are the authors’ own, and every LLM-assisted passage, proof, and script was checked by the authors, who take full responsibility for its content.

blocks.en: In Sec. 5.1 , we saw empirically ( Fig. 4 ) that modifying the DDIM step ( 7 ) to move toward a Gaussian sample with the posterior’s mean and covariance ( 10 ) reaches a given error in far fewer steps than standard DDIM, which uses only the posterior mean. This gap motivates our view of guidance in Sec. 5.2 as turning two posterior-mean estimators into a prediction that carries the posterior covariance. Below we derive the convergence rates stated in Sec. 5.1 : with K K steps, the Gaussian-kernel MMD to p data p_{\mathrm{data}} is O ⁡ ( K − 1 ) O(K^{-1}) for standard DDIM using the exact posterior mean, denoted M ⁡ ( 1 ) M(1) , and O ⁡ ( K − 2 ) O(K^{-2}) for the sampler using the exact posterior mean and covariance, denoted M ⁡ ( 2 ) M(2) .

blocks.en: The sampler M ⁡ ( 2 ) M(2) adds noise with the posterior covariance to the DDIM step. Schioppa and Salimans [57] recently proposed a sampler of this form, which estimates the covariance with Tweedie’s formula and one Jacobian-vector product of the denoiser per step, and showed that it improves few-step sampling of pixel-space models. For DDPM with Gaussian reverse kernels, Akhtar et al. [4] prove the analogous gap in path-space KL divergence: Ω ⁡ ( 1 / K ) \Omega(1/K) with an isotropic reverse covariance and O ⁡ ( 1 / K 2 ) O(1/K^{2}) with the posterior covariance, which they sample with Lanczos iterations of Jacobian-vector products. The derivation above gives the same gap for the DDIM step, measured by the MMD to the data. Both samplers estimate the covariance at every step at the cost of extra network evaluations; in our interpretation ( Sec. 5.2 ), guidance obtains a perturbation with the posterior’s covariance from the second forward pass that guided models already compute.

[4] 证明路径- 空格 KL 相差的相差 : 相差 Q( 1 / K )\ Omega( 1/ K ) 具有异构反向共变, 而 O = ( 1 / K 2) O( 1/ K^{ 2 ) 具有后向共变, 它们与 Lanczos 迭代的 Jacobian- vector 产品进行抽样 。 上面的推论给出了DDIM步骤的相同差距,由MMD对数据进行测量. 两位采样员估计每个步骤的共性都以额外的网络评价为代价;在我们的解释(第5.2节)中,指导与后方的共性从第二个前传获得扰动,而指导模型已经计算出来。

In reality, however, neural networks are known to have a smoothness bias [ 53 ] . To model this effect in a simple and intuitive way, we consider the case where the neural network is piecewise constant over a fixed set of cells.

A.5 Training as a weighted moving average
blocks.zh: A.5 培训为加权移动平均数

blocks.en: Section 7 finds that checkpoints need smaller scales than Eq. 22 implies. The derivation in Sec. A.4 supposes that the network keeps all training targets with equal weight. It is more accurate to model training with stochastic gradient descent as a weighted moving average. Each step moves the weights toward the current batch, so the network reflects its recent batches more than its early ones. We model this and derive its effect on the scale for checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 第7节认为,检查站需要比Eq.22所暗示的规模小。 在Sec.A.4中的推论认为,网络将所有训练目标保持同等重量. 更准确的做法是,将具有一定坡度的梯度下降作为加权移动平均值的训练模式。 每一步将权重移向目前的批量,所以网络反映的最近批量超过早期批量. 我们树立这个模型,并从中得出对检查站规模的影响。

blocks.en: Every comparison evaluates on the same held-out prompts or examples, using those same ground-truth examples as the real reference set unless noted otherwise. We calibrate at every sampler step, except for MDM where we use 50 50 evenly spaced steps out of 1,000 1{,}000 . • COCO [ 37 ] : val2014 photos with short side at least 480 480 px, shuffled in a fixed random order, center-cropped to 480 2 480^{2} , and prompted with the longest of their five captions. Photos 0–5,704 are used for calibration and 5,705–15,704 for evaluation. Although 480 2 480^{2} is below the models’ native resolution, upsampling COCO would blur x 0 x_{0} and artificially reduce the target data variance. • MJHQ-30K [ 34 ] : native 1024 2 1024^{2} resolution; images 0–1,023 are used for calibration and 5,705–15,704 for evaluation. • UCF-101 [ 63 ] : for SVD, the first frame of each clip (center-cropped to 16:9 and resized to 1024 × 576 1024{\times}576 ) conditions generation, and the real clips receive the same preprocessing at 7 7 fps. • OpenVid-1M [ 48 ] : calibration clips are taken from parts 30–70 and evaluation captions from parts 80–140, resampled to each model’s native frame rate, frame count, and spatial size. • Bridge [ 67 ] : the split of Zhu et al. [74] used to evaluate Cosmos-Predict2.5. Validation calibration chunks are teacher-forced, and the variance moments are computed only over the generated latent frames; evaluation rolls out on the test episodes. • AudioCaps [ 30 ] : 2,223 2{,}223 validation captions (from 445 445 clips) for calibration and all 4,411 4{,}411 test captions (from 884 884 clips) for evaluation. • Song Describer [ 45 ] : 356 356 captions (from 260 260 tracks) for calibration and 586 586 separate non-vocal captions for evaluation. • KIT-ML [ 52 ] : 288 288 validation motions (with three noise draws each, 864 864 total) for calibration; evaluation uses 20 20 replications of 1,000 1{,}000 test motions against the test set as reference.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,每一次比较都对相同的搁置提示或实例进行评价,使用与实际参考集相同的地面真实实例。 除了MDM, 我们使用1000个1{,}000个平方步中的50个平方步。 COCO [37] : val2014照片, 短边至少480 480 px, 固定随机排列, 中间缩放为480 2 480 ^{2}, 并用5个标题中最长的标注来激发。 0–5,704照片用于校准,5,705–15,704照片用于评价. 虽然480 2 480 ^{2}低于模型的本地分辨率, • MJHQ-30K [34]:原生1024 2 1024^{2}分辨率;图像0–1,023用于校准,5,705–15,704用于评价. ^ UCF-101 [63]:对于SVD来说,每段剪辑的第一帧(中央-剪辑为16:9,并调整为1024×576 1024\times}576)条件生成,真实的剪辑在7英尺时得到相同的预处理. · OpenVid-1M [48]:校准剪辑取自第30至70部分,评价标题取自第80至140部分,再复制到每个模型的原生帧率、帧计数和空间大小。 •桥[67]:朱等人的分割. [74]用于评价宇宙-预测2.5. 校验校准块是教师强制的,差异瞬间只计算在产生的潜伏框上;评价在测试中展开。 • 校准音频字幕[30]:2 223 2{,}223 校准字幕(从445 445个剪辑)和所有4 411 4{,}411个测试字幕(从884 884个剪辑)用于评价。 • 歌曲描述器[45]:用于校准的356 356个字幕(来自260个音轨)和用于评价的586 586个单独的非语音字幕。 • KIT-ML [52]:288 288 验证动议(每个有3个噪声抽取,864 846 共)用于校准;评价使用20 20 复制1000 1{,}000 个测试动议,以对照试验集作为参考.

blocks.en: • Images : FID and FD DINOv2 using the Inception-v3 and DINOv2 ViT-L/14 feature extractors from the EDM2 codebase [ 29 ] (both real and generated images resized to 256 2 256^{2} ); precision, recall, density, and coverage [ 47 ] with k = 3 k=3 on the same features; and CLIP score using CLIP ViT-L/14. • Video : FVD and k k -NN metrics on StyleGAN-V’s I3D features [ 58 ] , computed over 16 16 evenly spaced frames (OpenVid-1M models) or non-overlapping 16 16 -frame windows (Cosmos-Predict2.5); CLIP-T averages CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity across 8 8 frames against the prompt. • Audio : each model’s standard evaluation suite. Cosmos-Predict2.5 uses a bootstrap over its 100 100 episodes, MDM its 20 20 replications, and Stable Audio Open the paired standard error over captions. blocks.en: Each denoiser uses the preconditioning of Karras et al. [27] around a four-layer MLP ( 128 128 hidden units per layer, SiLU activations) that takes the scaled noisy point together with sine and cosine features of log ⁡ σ \log\sigma at eight frequencies. We train each model with the denoising loss of Karras et al. [27] , drawing log-normal noise levels ln ⁡ σ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( − 1.0 , 1.4 2 ) \ln\sigma\sim\mathcal{N}(-1.0,1.4^{2}) , for 40,000 40{,}000 steps with batch size 512 512 . We test two optimizers, Adam (learning rate 2 × 10 − 3 2\times 10^{-3} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.99 ) \beta=(0.9,0.99) ) and SGD (momentum 0.9 0.9 , learning rate 0.1 0.1 ), both with a 500 500 -step linear warm-up followed by cosine decay. To directly control the number of training samples each network sees (standing in for the finite sample budget of finite-step training in Sec. 5.2 and Sec. A.2 ), we vary the training-set size N ∈ { 64,128 , … , 4 , 096 } N\in\{64,128,\dots,4{,}096\} and train 1,024 1{,}024 independent models per N N , each on its own fresh sample of N N training points and with its own random seed.

To evaluate the trained models, we fix 256 256 noisy test inputs x t ∼ p σ x_{t}\sim p_{\sigma} at each noise level σ ∈ { 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.4 , 0.8 , 1.6 } \sigma\in\{0.1,0.2,0.4,0.8,1.6\} and use the same inputs across all N N and all models. At each input, we record every network’s prediction alongside the exact posterior mean of its N N -point empirical training set (the gray reference curve in Fig. 1 e). Figure 1 shows one of these inputs at σ = 0.4 \sigma=0.4 , and the shaded bands on the axis angle in Fig. 1 e are 5–95% bootstrap intervals over the 1,024 1{,}024 models. At this input, the spread of Adam-trained networks stays within 8 % 8\% of the exact empirical posterior mean up to N = 512 N=512 , and then grows slightly larger ( 14 % 14\% more at N = 1,024 N=1{,}024 and 38 % 38\% more at N = 4,096 N=4{,}096 ). The cloud of network predictions also becomes rounder at large N N , because the networks’ own function-approximation error (which does not follow the shape of Σ \Sigma ) becomes comparable to the shrinking finite-sample spread.

blocks.en: B.3 CFG on ImageNet: label information versus model error
blocks.zh: B.3 图像网上的CFG:标签信息与模型错误

blocks.en: This section describes the setup behind Fig. 2 , which separates conditioning signal from model error in CFG on ImageNet-64.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍Fig. 2背后的设置,该设置在ImageNet-64上的CFG中将调节信号与模型错误区分开来.

blocks.en: Because EDM2’s released ImageNet-64 models are strictly class-conditional, we train two EDM2-XS models with classifier-free label dropout ( p = 0.1 p=0.1 ) [ 22 ] . Both follow the edm2-img64-xs preset of Karras et al. [29] for 2 27 2^{27} training images at batch size 2,048 2{,}048 (one-sixteenth of the published XS schedule), using two random seeds ( 0 0 and 1 1 , denoted runs A A and B B ). Changing the seed varies the weight initialization, data order, and noise draws. Throughout, we evaluate the training EMA weights at length 0.100 0.100 and obtain the unconditional prediction by passing the zero label vector. Adding label dropout has little effect on seed-to-seed variability: the conditional-only runs trained for checkpoint guidance ( Sec. B.7 ) with the same preset and seeds differ by ‖ D A ​ ( x t , c ) − D B ​ ( x t , c ) ‖ 2 = 13.3 \|D_{A}(x_{t},c)-D_{B}(x_{t},c)\|^{2}=13.3 per image at σ = 2.9 \sigma=2.9 , compared with 12.6 12.6 for the label-dropout pair.

blocks.en: To approximate the true posterior mean, we use the released EDM2-XL model (EMA length 0.040 0.040 ), which has nine times as many parameters and was trained by Karras et al. [29] on five times as many images. This proxy is still not exact: at σ = 2.9 \sigma=2.9 , EDM2-L achieves a lower denoising error than XL, implying that XL itself has a squared error of at least 13 13 per image there, while the conditional XS models lie at squared distance 75 75 per image from XL. The conditional-error curve in Fig. 2 therefore includes a small contribution from XL’s own error. Importantly, the decomposition of Δ \Delta into seed-dependent and systematic parts below does not depend on XL at all.
blocks.zh: 为了大致表示真正的后期含义,我们使用发布的EDM2-XL模型(EMA长度为0.040 0.040),其参数是Karras等人所训练的9倍. [29] 在5倍的图像上. 这个代理仍然不准确:在\\sigma=2.9时,EDM2-L实现比XL更低的去诺错误,意味着XL本身的平方误差至少是每张图像13个,而有条件的XS模型则位于每张图像75个离XL的平方距离. 因此,图2中的条件-错误曲线包含XL自身错误产生的小贡献。 重要的是,将 \\ Delta 分解成下面的种子依赖性和系统性部件完全不依赖于 XL 。

These correspond to steps 1–11, 12–16, 17–19, 20–23, and 24–32 of the noise grid (because each Heun step evaluates the denoiser twice, its second evaluation can land in the next window). For every window, we generate 10,000 10{,}000 images using the same initial noise and class labels and compute FID against the ImageNet-64 training set as in EDM2. Both training seeds agree on whether guidance helps or hurts in every window.
B.4 Errors of EDM2 networks on ImageNet-64
blocks.zh: B.4 ImageNet-64上的EDM2网络的错误

blocks.en: This section describes the setup for Figs. 8 and 9 , which test whether autoguidance reduces denoising error on ImageNet-64. Following the FID setup of Karras et al. [28] (who use w = 1.7 w=1.7 ), we guide EDM2-S (EMA length 0.045 0.045 , trained on 2 30 2^{30} images) with an EDM2-XS model trained on 2 27 2^{27} images, an eighth of S’s budget (EMA length 0.110 0.110 ). We use EDM2-XL (EMA length 0.040 0.040 , 1.1 1.1 B parameters versus 280 280 M for S) as a proxy for the posterior mean D ⋆ D^{\star} .
blocks.zh: 本节介绍Figs. 8和9的设置,它们测试自动引导是否减少ImageNet-64上的去诺化错误. 继Karras等人[28]的FID设置(他们使用w=1.7 w=1.7)之后,我们指导EDM2-S(EMA长度0.045 0.045,在2 30 2 = 30}图像上培训),使用2 27 2 = 27}图像上培训的EDM2-XS模型,是S预算的八分之一(EMA长度0.110 0.110). 我们使用EDM2-XL(EMA长度0.040 0.040,1.1 1.1 B参数相对于S的280 280 M参数)作为后人指DQQD^{\star}的代名词.

blocks.en: We evaluate on 10,000 10{,}000 ImageNet validation images ( 10 10 per class, center-cropped to 64 × 64 64\times 64 as in EDM2), adding one shared noise draw per image at each of the 32 32 noise levels of the EDM2 sampler. Expectations are averaged over these images. All errors are single-step denoising errors on forward-noised real images (not along guided sampling trajectories), measured as squared Euclidean distance in pixel space per coordinate ( d = 12,288 d=12{,}288 ). The additional pairs mentioned in Sec. C.1 (EDM2-L guided by S or M, and S guided by itself at EMA length 0.075 0.075 ) use the exact same validation images and noise draws.
blocks.zh: 我们估计10 000 10{,} 000 ImageNet验证图像(每类10个10个,中央剪切为64×64 64\times 64,如EDM2),在EDM2采样器的32个32个噪声等级中,每个图像都增加了1个共享噪声图. 对这些图像的期望是平均的。 所有错误都是在向前点名的真实图像上(而不是在引导取样轨迹上)的单步解码错误,按每坐标像素空间的平方Euclidea距离(d=12,288 d=12{,}288)测量. 在Sec.C.1(EDM2-L由S或M指导,S则由自己指导,长度为0.075 0.075)中提到的附加对子使用完全相同的验证图像和噪声画.

B.3 , EDM2-XL is an imperfect proxy for D ⋆ D^{\star} : between σ ≈ 2 \sigma\approx 2 and σ ≈ 8 \sigma\approx 8 , EDM2-S actually has a 0.1 0.1 – 0.3 % 0.3\% lower denoising error than XL, and above σ ≈ 10 \sigma\approx 10 the two agree within bootstrap noise. Any error of XL that is independent of both models adds equally to both estimated errors and biases the shared-error ratio κ = 𝔼 t ​ [ α 0 ​ α 1 ] / 𝔼 t ​ [ α 1 2 ] \kappa=\mathbb{E}_{t}[\alpha_{0}\alpha_{1}]/\mathbb{E}_{t}[\alpha_{1}^{2}] (the fraction of the strong model’s error that the weak model repeats, with α 0 , α 1 \alpha_{0},\alpha_{1} as in Sec. A.6 ) upward toward 1 1 . To check this, for the two pairs with S as the strong model we repeat the measurement using the average of EDM2-M, L, and XL as D ⋆ D^{\star} , which lowers κ \kappa from 0.55 0.55 – 0.67 0.67 to 0.29 0.29 – 0.54 0.54 , reinforcing the conclusion that κ < 1 \kappa<1 .

For the sample-quality curves in Fig. 8 , we generate 10,000 10{,}000 images per scale with EDM2’s deterministic 32 32 -step Heun sampler (seeds 0 0 through 9,999 9{,}999 and random class labels) across w ∈ { − 0.5 , − 0.25 , … , 1.5 , 1.7 , 2.0 , 2.25 , 2.5 , 3.0 } w\in\{-0.5,-0.25,\dots,1.5,1.7,2.0,2.25,2.5,3.0\} , and compute FID and FD DINOv2 against EDM2’s ImageNet-64 training reference statistics. Because we use 10,000 10{,}000 samples rather than 50,000 50{,}000 , the absolute FID numbers are not directly comparable to the 50,000 50{,}000 -sample values reported by Karras et al. [28] .

We measure sample quality using Gaussian-kernel MMD to the data [ 20 ] , with kernel bandwidth 0.3 0.3 on the 2D mixture and half the median nearest-neighbor distance between images on ImageNet-64 (so that only samples landing close to real images score well). The data expectation in MMD is computed directly from the data distribution. To establish the finite-sample noise floor, we evaluate eight independent runs of 10 6 10^{6} exact data samples; points within two standard deviations of zero are plotted on the floor.

blocks.en: To find the metric-tuned constants in Tabs. 2 and 5 , we sweep constant guidance scales using each model’s released sampler, score 10,000 10{,}000 COCO images per scale, and pick the best scale for each metric individually. On SD 3.5 Medium we test 42 42 scales from w = 1 w=1 to 14 14 , a coarse grid refined to steps of 0.1 0.1 around each metric’s optimum ( 40 40 Euler steps), and on SD 1.5 we sweep w = 1 w=1 to 16 16 in steps of 0.5 0.5 ( 50 50 PNDM steps).

blocks.en: B.7 Guiding with an earlier checkpoint
blocks.zh: B.7 与较早的检查站进行指导

blocks.en: For Guidance as Variance Matching ( Sec. 7 ), we train two conditional-only EDM2-XS models on ImageNet-64 (runs A A and B B ) using the same preset, seeds, and EMA length ( 0.100 0.100 ) as in Sec. B.3 without label dropout, for T = 2 27 T=2^{27} images, saving checkpoints every 2 20 2^{20} images. We take the strong model from either run at budget T T or T / 2 T/2 , and pair it with a weak guide at fraction r ∈ { 1 / 8 , 1 / 4 , 1 / 2 , 3 / 4 } r\in\{1/8,1/4,1/2,3/4\} of that budget, taken either from the same run (checkpoint) or from the other run (independent model). For each pair we generate 10,000 10{,}000 images with EDM2’s 32 32 -step Heun sampler (shared initial noise and class labels) across w ∈ { 1 , 1.25 , 1.5 , 2 , 2.5 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6.5 , 8 } w\in\{1,1.25,1.5,2,2.5,3,4,5,6.5,8\} , find the optimal scale w ⋆ w^{\star} from a quadratic fit to FID or FD DINOv2 in log ⁡ w \log w , and compute w cp ⋆ / w id ⋆ w^{\star}_{\mathrm{cp}}/w^{\star}_{\mathrm{id}} . Where guidance does not improve FID ( r = 1 / 8 r=1/8 , and r = 1 / 4 r=1/4 at budget T T ), both optima are w = 1 w=1 and the ratio is 1 1 .

The dashed curve in Guidance as Variance Matching fits the single memory-length parameter L L of the EMA model ( Sec. A.5 ) by least squares to the eight averaged ratios (pooling both seeds and strong budgets per metric and r r ), using one step per 2 20 2^{20} images at budget T T , which gives L = 0.69 ​ T L=0.69\,T . Because direct estimates from unguided predictions are shorter, L L is best viewed as an effective summary of the scale ratios rather than a literal SGD memory length.
blocks.zh: 作为差异匹配的“指导”的破碎曲线与EMA模型(Sec.A.5)的单个内存长参数LL相匹配,以最小的正方形与8个平均比值(将种子和强有力的预算组合在一起,每公吨和r.),在预算T 中采用每2 20 2 = 20]个步骤的图像,这给L = 0.69 T = 0.69\,T。 由于未经指导的预测得出的直接估计数较短,LL 最好被看作是比例的有效总结,而不是一个字面的SGD内存长度。

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional experiments
blocks.zh: 附录C 其他实验

blocks.en: C.1 Guidance moves the prediction away from the posterior mean
blocks.zh: C.1 联合国 引导将预测移离后期含义

blocks.en: In Sec. 4 , we found that the guidance scales used in practice improve sample quality despite increasing denoising error. Here, we examine this discrepancy more closely. We first test whether averaging over noise levels hides any benefit of guidance for predicting the posterior mean. We then compare mean-estimation accuracy and sample quality on a single model pair, and finally examine why the shared-error explanation of guidance does not account for these results.
blocks.zh: 在第4节中,我们发现,在实践中使用的指导尺度提高了样本质量,尽管去名误越来越多。 在这里,我们更仔细地审查这一差异。 我们首先测试平均高于噪音水平是否隐藏了预测后期含义的指导的任何好处。 然后我们比较一个模型对的平均值精确度和样本质量,最后审查为什么对指导的共享-错误解释没有说明这些结果。

It stays below 1 1 along the sampler, far below the published scales of 1.7 1.7 to 6 6 . blocks.zh: 第4节报告在取样器上集合的MSE-最佳比例(47);图7逐级解决了图3和图3的5对和1对跨型对. 它沿着取样器一直低于1 1,远远低于公布的1.7至6 6的比额。 这排除了集合尺度隐藏一些噪声水平的可能性,在这些噪声水平上,指导可以改善预测.

blocks.en: We test this on the pair for which autoguidance was introduced, EDM2-S guided by the smaller EDM2-XS on ImageNet-64. The denoising error splits as 𝔼 t ​ ‖ D w − x 0 ‖ 2 = 𝔼 t ​ ‖ D w − D ⋆ ‖ 2 + 𝔼 t ​ ‖ x 0 − D ⋆ ‖ 2 \mathbb{E}_{t}\|D_{w}-x_{0}\|^{2}=\mathbb{E}_{t}\|D_{w}-D^{\star}\|^{2}+\mathbb{E}_{t}\|x_{0}-D^{\star}\|^{2} , and the second term does not depend on w w , so the denoising error and the distance to the posterior mean D ⋆ D^{\star} change together. With the largest network, EDM2-XL, standing in for D ⋆ D^{\star} , the guided prediction is closest to it at w ⋆ = 0.75 w^{\star}=0.75 ( Fig. 8 a). The sample metrics prefer very different scales: FID is best at w = 1.7 w=1.7 , the scale Karras et al. [28] report, and FD DINOv2 \mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{DINOv2}} at w = 2.5 w=2.5 ( Fig. 8 b,c). At w = 1.7 w=1.7 the prediction is 2.1 2.1 – 2.5 2.5 times further from D ⋆ D^{\star} than S alone, further even than the weaker XS, and at w ⋆ w^{\star} FID is 1.4 1.4 and FD DINOv2 \mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{DINOv2}} 2.5 2.5 times its best value. The two objectives are therefore not just mildly misaligned but pull in opposite directions from w = 1 w=1 . This is the trade that motivates the paper, seen in full on one pair, as for SD 3.5 Medium in Fig. 3 c: guidance gives up accuracy in the posterior mean for better samples, so a rule that picks the scale must look at something other than the mean, which for us is the variance ( Sec. 5 ).

A.6 , taking the shared axis along S’s error E 1 = D 1 − D ⋆ E_{1}=D_{1}-D^{\star} sets α 1 = ‖ E 1 ‖ \alpha_{1}=\|E_{1}\| , β 1 = 0 \beta_{1}=0 , and α 0 \alpha_{0} to the projection of XS’s error onto E 1 E_{1} . By ( 49 ), w MSE ⋆ > 1 w_{\mathrm{MSE}}^{\star}>1 holds exactly when κ = 𝔼 t ​ [ α 0 ​ α 1 ] / 𝔼 t ​ [ α 1 2 ] > 1 \kappa=\mathbb{E}_{t}[\alpha_{0}\alpha_{1}]/\mathbb{E}_{t}[\alpha_{1}^{2}]>1 . Unlike the idealized κ = 2 \kappa=2 case ( Fig. 9 a), XS repeats only about 0.6 0.6 of S’s error across all noise levels and adds a comparable orthogonal error ( Fig. 9 b,c), so the scale closest to D ⋆ D^{\star} stays below 1 1 ( Fig. 9 d, matching Fig. 7 ). The same holds per input (bands in Fig. 9 c) and for EDM2-L guided by S or M. Using XL as a proxy is conservative, since its own error enters both differences identically and pulls κ \kappa toward 1 1 . The only exception we found is guiding S with a longer EMA from the same run, where shared training aligns the errors and lifts w ⋆ w^{\star} above 1 1 . For separate models, each denoiser’s error is largely independent, which explains w MSE ⋆ < 1 w_{\mathrm{MSE}}^{\star}<1 and supports Sec. 5.3 : D 1 − D 0 D_{1}-D_{0} acts as a random vector that guidance rescales to match the posterior covariance ( Sec. 5.2 ).
C.2 Why CFG and autoguidance differ at high noise
blocks.zh: C.2 联合国 为什么CFG和自动导引在高噪音时不同

blocks.en: Our interpretation of guidance relies on the two predictions having compatible means and covariance directions, so that rescaling their difference can restore the posterior covariance ( Sec. 5.2 ). Here, we examine how these properties change throughout sampling. We first follow the two CFG predictions of SD 3.5 Medium for one prompt, which align in the noise range where guidance helps, and then compare CFG with autoguidance for one ImageNet class.
blocks.zh: 我们对指导的解释依赖于两种具有兼容手段和共变方向的预测,这样,它们之间的差别的调整可以恢复后共变(第5.2节)。 在这里,我们审查这些特性如何在整个取样过程中变化。 我们首先遵循SD 3.5 Medium的两种CFG预测,一种是即时的,它使导线有帮助的噪声范围一致,然后将CFG与一个ImageNet类的自动导线进行比较.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : The two predictions of a guided pair along the sampler, without guidance ( w = 1 w=1 ), over 1,000 1{,}000 seeds; x 0 x_{0} are the final samples. Left: SD 3.5 Medium, one prompt. Middle and right: EDM2-S on ImageNet-64, one class (school bus), 32 32 Heun steps, guided by CFG or by autoguidance with EDM2-XS. D 1 D_{1} is the conditional prediction for CFG and EDM2-S for autoguidance; D 0 D_{0} is the unconditional prediction or EDM2-XS. (a) 𝔼 x t ​ ‖ v 1 − v 0 ‖ 2 \mathbb{E}_{x_{t}}\|v_{1}-v_{0}\|^{2} per coordinate, over the 1,000 1{,}000 states x t x_{t} at each step; shading marks where CFG harms or is unnecessary according to Kynkäänniemi et al. [33] . (b) Direction alignment: the overlap of the top- 50 50 principal subspaces ( 1 1 : the same directions).

CFG is known to harm sample quality at high noise and help primarily within a middle range of noise levels [ 33 ] . Our view suggests an explanation: at high noise, the conditional and unconditional predictions may differ substantially in both their values and covariance directions, making their difference unsuitable for restoring the posterior covariance. To examine this, the left column of Fig. 10 follows the two predictions of SD 3.5 Medium over 1,000 1{,}000 unguided sampling trajectories with the same prompt. As noise decreases, their mean squared velocity difference 𝔼 x t ​ ‖ v c − v u ‖ 2 \mathbb{E}_{x_{t}}\|v_{c}-v_{u}\|^{2} , averaged over the 1,000 1{,}000 states x t x_{t} at each step, falls tenfold during the high-noise steps where guidance harms, and another tenfold through the interval where it helps ( Fig. 10 a). At the same time, the overlap of their top- 50 50 principal covariance subspaces approaches 1 1 , indicating that their predictions vary along increasingly similar directions ( Fig. 10 b). Thus, the noise range where CFG helps is also where its two predictions become close and their covariance directions align, consistent with our variance-matching interpretation.
blocks.zh: CFG已知在高噪声时会损害样品质量,主要在噪声水平的中间范围帮助[33]. 我们的观点提出了一个解释:在高噪声下,有条件和无条件的预测在价值和共变方向上可能存在很大差异,使其差异不适合恢复后共变. 为了检查这一点,图10的左栏沿用了SD 3.5 中度超过1000 1{,}000无制导采样轨迹的两种预测,以同样的速度进行. 随着噪音的减少,它们的平均方形速度差E x t → v → c → v → 2\ mathbb{ E}_{x_{t}}\|v_{c}—v_{u}\|^{2},平均在每一步1000 1{,}000状态 x t_{t}中,在高噪音步骤中,导引损害会下降十倍,在它帮助的间隔中再下降十倍(图10 a). 同时,其前50个主共变子空间的重叠接近1 1 ,表明其预测沿越来越相似的方向变化(图10 b). 因此,CFG帮助的噪声范围也是它的两个预测接近,它们的共变方向一致的地方,这与我们的差异比对解释一致.

blocks.en: If this mismatch explains why CFG harms at high noise, it should be less pronounced in autoguidance. Unlike CFG, whose conditional and unconditional branches target different distributions, autoguidance combines two models trained toward the same target, differing primarily in their approximation errors. We test this prediction on ImageNet-64 using EDM2-S with CFG and with EDM2-XS autoguidance (middle and right columns of Fig. 10 ). CFG shows the same pattern as SD 3.5: its predictions are farther apart and their covariance directions differ at high noise, becoming aligned only later in sampling. In contrast, autoguidance’s velocity predictions are about ten times closer during the high-noise steps, and their covariance directions are already aligned. This agrees with the finding that CFG improves when the high-noise steps are excluded [ 33 ] , whereas autoguidance works throughout sampling [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 如果这种不匹配解释了为什么CFG在高噪声下造成伤害,那么在自动引导中就应该不那么明显. 与CFG不同的是,它有条件和无条件的分支针对不同的分布,自动指导结合了两个模式,它们训练的对象是同一个目标,主要在近似误差上有所不同. 我们在ImageNet-64上使用带CFG的EDM2-S和EDM2-XS自动指导(图10的中列和右列)测试这一预测. CFG显示了与SD 3.5相同的模式:它的预测相距较远,它们的共变方向在高噪声时不同,只在采样时才逐渐趋同. 相比之下,在高噪音步骤中,自动指导的速度预测接近了十倍左右,它们的共变方向已经一致。 这与以下结论一致:当高噪音步骤被排除在外时,CFG会有所改善[33],而自动指导则在整个取样过程中起作用[28]。

blocks.en: C.3 Guidance reduces diversity
blocks.zh: C.3 指导减少多样性

blocks.en: Our interpretation in Sec. 5.2 treats the errors of a model pair as random samples from the posterior covariance. However, Eq. 10 draws fresh noise at every step, whereas a fixed pair of trained models produces a deterministic error field: nearby inputs receive similar errors. The spatial range of these correlations depends on the noise level. At large σ \sigma , the model cannot distinguish fine details, and its errors are shared across a broad region of input space. Guidance amplifies these shared errors, potentially directing nearby sampling trajectories toward the same modes rather than letting them explore different ones.
blocks.zh: 我们在第5.2节中的解释将模型对的误差作为随机样本从后共变中处理. 然而,Eq. 10在每一个步骤都画出新的噪音,而一对固定的训练有素的模型则产生一个确定性错误场:附近的输入收到类似的错误. 这些关联的空间范围取决于噪音水平. 总的来说\sigma,该模型无法区分细细的细节,其错误在输入空间的广大区域共享. 指导放大了这些共同的错误,有可能将附近的取样轨迹引向相同的模式,而不是让他们探索不同的模式。

blocks.en: Section 7 shows that guiding SD 1.5 and CommonCanvas away from each other improves both models, contrary to a simple error-correction explanation. We find the same with the two other pairs that share SD 1.5’s latent space, SD 2.1 with SD 1.5 and with CommonCanvas ( Fig. 13 ): every tested scale outside [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , from − 4 -4 to 5 5 , improves both FID and FD DINOv2 in all four directions, with 95 % 95\% confidence intervals excluding zero. Although SD 2.1 is the stronger model in both pairs, guiding the weaker model away from it matches or surpasses its quality. In contrast, averaging the models ( w = 0.5 w=0.5 ) never outperforms the better one.
blocks.zh: 第7节显示,指导SD 1.5和CommonCanvas相互远离可以改进两种模型,这与简单的错误校正解释相反. 我们发现其他两对共享SD 1.5潜在空间,SD 2.1与SD 1.5和CommonCanvas(图13):每一次测试外的[0,1] [0,1] 尺度,从− 4-4到5 5,所有四个方向的FID和FD DINov2都有改进,95%的95%的置信间隔排除0. 虽然SD 2.1是两对中较强的模型,但引导较弱的模型远离它与它匹配或超过它的质量. 相比之下,平均模型(w = 0.5 w = 0.5)的性能从未超过更好的模型.

blocks.en: The SD models differ in their training data, so their gains might still reflect systematic differences. We therefore train two EDM2-XS models on ImageNet-64 with the same recipe ( 2 25 2^{25} training images) but different seeds, and evaluate them with the 32-step Heun sampler using shared noise and labels. Neither model has a systematic advantage, yet extrapolation improves both FID and FD DINOv2 in both directions at EMA lengths 0.035 0.035 and 0.050 0.050 ( Fig. 14 ). At 0.050 0.050 , the best FID gains are about 0.4 0.4 for A A and 0.2 0.2 for B B , while averaging again offers no gain. This is consistent with our interpretation: even independent estimates of the same posterior mean can provide useful differences for guidance ( Sec. 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: SD模型在培训数据上有所不同,因此其收益可能仍然反映了系统的差异. 因此,我们在ImageNet-64上培训了两个EDM2-XS模型,其配有相同的食谱(2 25 2^{25}训练图像),但种子不同,并使用共用噪声和标签的32步Heun采样器对其进行评价. 两个模型都没有系统优势,但外推法在EMA长度0.035 0.035和0.050 0.050(图14)两个方向上都改善了FID和FD DINov2. 在0.0500.050年时,AA的最佳粮食进口收益约为0.4 0.4,BB为0.2 0.2,而平均仍无收益。 这与我们的解释是一致的:即使对同一后期含义的独立估计也可为指导提供有益的区别(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: As the EMA length increases, the benefit of guidance disappears ( Fig. 14 ). The best FID gain on A A ’s side drops from 0.8 0.8 at EMA 0.035 0.035 to 0.4 0.4 at 0.050 0.050 , and vanishes at 0.100 0.100 . Moreover, guiding the shorter-EMA models never outperforms the longer-EMA models alone. This suggests that between seeds, guidance amplifies the variation left by stochastic training, which longer EMA already averages away ( Sec. A.5 ).
blocks.zh: 随着EMA长度的增大,导线的好处也随之消失(图14). A的侧面最佳FID增益从EMA 0.035 0.035的0.8降至0.050 0.04,以0.100 0.100 消失。 此外,指导更短的EMA模型从未仅次于更长的EMA模型。 这表明,在种子之间,制导会扩大Stochtic training留下的变异,而这种变异更长时间的EMA已经平均了(Sec.A.5.)。

blocks.en: Our rule gives larger scales than those published for EDM2 on ImageNet-512: for EDM2-XXL guided by an unconditional EDM2-XS (classifier-free guidance) and by EDM2-M (autoguidance), our constants are about five times the published ones ( Tab. 6 ). Unlike most published scales, whose choice is undocumented ( Sec. 6.1 ), these come from a grid search over the scale and EMA lengths, run separately for FID and for FD DINOv2 [ 29 , 28 ] ; Tab. 6 uses the FID-optimal ones. We think this is why the two differ, as these metrics need not track what people prefer: on SD 3.5 Medium, users rated the scales tuned to FID and FD DINOv2 below ours ( Tabs. 2 and 1 ). We ran no user study on ImageNet; Tab. 6 reports every metric at the published scales and with our constant and schedule, and Figs. 21 and 24 show 100 100 pairs at the published scales and with our schedule.

blocks.en: The choice matters for our main claim, that the constant scale recovers the scales used in practice ( Guidance as Variance Matching ). Table 7 compares the three scales with the published one on the models of Guidance as Variance Matching . Our condition ( 53 ) is the closest to the published scale on eight of the eleven models and has the smallest median error, while the other two give smaller scales than ours on every model but Cosmos-Predict2.5. Matching the average variance is therefore both the simplest of the three objectives, with a closed form, and the one that best recovers the scales chosen in practice.

Here, we ask how many examples the fit actually needs, since this sets the cost of our rule and whether it applies when little data is at hand. We refit the constant scale on random subsets of the calibration set, for SD 3.5 Medium ( 40 40 levels) and AudioLDM 2 ( 2,223 2{,}223 AudioCaps captions, 200 200 levels), keeping every level and each example’s noise draws. Each subset is fitted from its own examples alone, including the means in Eq. 18 , and we draw 2,000 2{,}000 subsets per size.

blocks.en: D.4 Noise with the right variance but not the posterior’s covariance
blocks.zh: D.4 有适当差异的噪音,但后台的噪音不相同

blocks.en: In Sec. 5.1 , we argue that the variance added to the posterior mean must follow the posterior covariance Σ ⁡ ( x t ) = Cov x 0 ∼ p ⁡ ( x 0 | x t ) ⁡ ( x 0 ) \Sigma(x_{t})=\Cov_{x_{0}\sim p(x_{0}|x_{t})}(x_{0}) , as in the sampler of Eq. 10 : the right amount of variance with the wrong shape does not help. Guidance adds variance along D 1 − D 0 D_{1}-D_{0} , which follows Σ ⁡ ( x t ) \Sigma(x_{t}) at each input ( Eq. 14 ), while our rule only sets how much ( Sec. 5.3 ). Here, we ablate the direction by adding the same amount of variance with noise that ignores x t x_{t} . We expect this to fail, because Σ ⁡ ( x t ) \Sigma(x_{t}) depends on the input: it is large along the directions in which x t x_{t} leaves x 0 x_{0} uncertain and small along those it already determines. Noise that ignores x t x_{t} puts variance in directions the posterior has already settled, pushing samples off the data.

blocks.en: To test this on SD 3.5 Medium with the COCO protocol of Sec. B.1 , we sample without guidance and at every Euler step replace the prediction by D 1 ​ ( x t ) + η D_{1}(x_{t})+\eta , with η \eta zero-mean Gaussian, independent of x t x_{t} and drawn afresh at each step. Its variance restores that of the data at each step, as in Eq. 17 , so it adds as much variance as our schedule does. The noise is either isotropic or shaped like the data covariance Cov x 0 ∼ p data ⁡ ( x 0 ) \Cov_{x_{0}\sim p_{\mathrm{data}}}(x_{0}) .
blocks.zh: 为了在SD 3.5 Medium上用Sec.B.1的COCO协议进行测试,我们在没有指导的情况下进行取样,在每个欧勒步骤上用D 1 (x t) + η D_{1}(x_{t})+\ta 代替预测,用\eta 0-mean Gaussian, 独立于x t X_{t} 并在每一步骤上重新绘制. 其差异恢复了每一步骤的数据,如Eq.17中的数据,因此增加了与我们的时间表相同的差异。 噪音要么是异色的,要么是形状像数据共变的Cov x 0 ∼ p 数据 ⁡ (x 0)\Cov_{x _{ 0 }\ sim p_{\ mathrm{ data}}} (x_{0}).

The noise rows sample without guidance and add Gaussian noise to the prediction at every step, as much variance as our schedule adds. All rows share prompts and initial noise.

blocks.en: Both kinds of noise make every metric worse than sampling without guidance, and the data-shaped noise is mostly the worse of the two ( Tab. 9 ). Our schedule, which adds the same variance along D 1 − D 0 D_{1}-D_{0} , improves on no guidance in nearly every metric. Added variance therefore helps only when it follows the posterior covariance at each input, as Sec. 5.1 claims.
blocks.zh: 这两种噪声都使得每个公尺比没有指导的采样更糟糕,数据形状的噪声大多是两者中最差的(Tab. 9). 我们的日程沿D1 - D0 D_{1} - D_{0} 增加了同样的差异, 几乎每个度量都没有改进任何指导。 因此,如第5.1节所述,增加的差异只有在每次输入都遵循后共性时才有帮助。

blocks.en: E.2 User study
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 用户研究

blocks.en: The study of Sec. 6.1 compares seven settings on SD 3.5 Medium: the FID- and FD DINOv2 -tuned constants ( w = 1.6 w=1.6 , 2.4 2.4 ), our constant ( w = 4.14 w=4.14 ), our schedule, and the interval, linear, and TV-CFG schedules at the released w = 4.5 w=4.5 . Each setting renders held-out COCO captions 5,705–6,204 (40 Euler steps, 480 2 480^{2} ), with one initial noise per caption shared by all seven. We omit the published constant ( w = 4.5 w=4.5 ), since our predicted scale is already close to it.
blocks.zh: Sec 6.1的研究比较了SD 3.5 MED上的七个设置:FID-和FD DINov2 - 调制常数(w = 1.6 w = 1.6,2.4 2.4),我们的常数(w = 4.14 w = 4.14),我们的时间表,以及释放的w = 4.5 w = 4.5 的间隔,线性,TV-CFG时间表. 每个设定都让被搁置的COCO字幕5,705–6,204(40 Eular steps,480–2,480–^{2}),每个字幕有一个初始噪声,所有七个都共享. 我们省略了公布的常数(w = 4.5 w = 4.5),因为我们的预测尺度已经接近了.

blocks.en: A trial shows a caption and two of its images, from two settings, on random sides; the rater picks the better image or calls a tie. Each rater’s trials go through the 21 21 pairs of settings evenly and favor the captions they have seen least. Raters are identified by the name they enter, so one person on several devices counts once. The study was not reviewed by an institutional review board: it is an informal preference poll among volunteers, run through a link that the authors shared with their research group, friends, and an online community of AI developers, with no compensation, no personal or sensitive data beyond a self-chosen name used to count each person once, and no risk beyond viewing generated images, which were screened for unsuitable content. No formal consent was collected; following the link and voting was voluntary and could be stopped at any time. The tables count the 1,458 1{,}458 votes of 41 41 people; the authors’ votes and those of AI raters are left out. We fit a Bradley–Terry model in which a tie counts as half a win for each side, with one prior tie per pair, and report it on the Elo scale (mean 1000 1000 ; a 100 100 -point gap means the higher setting is preferred about 64 % 64\% of the time). The ± \pm in Tab. 1 is 1.96 1.96 standard deviations over 1,000 1{,}000 bootstrap resamples of raters, then of votes within each rater. Table 14 gives every pairwise result.
blocks.zh: 一个试验会从两个设置中随机显示一个标题和两个图像;评分者会选择更好的图像或称平局. 每个评分员的试验都通过21对21的设置, 鼠标由它们输入的名称来识别,因此数个设备上的一个人算一次. 该研究没有经过机构审查委员会的审查:这是志愿者之间的非正式偏好民意测验,通过作者与其研究小组,朋友,以及AI开发者网络社区共享的链接进行,除了用来计算每个人一次的自选名称之外,没有个人或敏感数据,除了观看生成的图像之外,没有风险,这些图像被筛选出不合适的内容. 没有取得正式同意;联系和表决之后是自愿的,可以随时停止。 表格中计有41,41人中的1,458票;提交人和AI的评票人没有计票。 我们搭配了布拉德利—泰利模型,其中平局每方计为半赢,每对前一个平局,并在埃洛比例(平均1000-1000;100-100点差距意味着较高设置在64%左右的64-%)上报. Tab 1 中的 ±\pm 是 1.96 1.96 标准差 超过 1000 1{,} 000 拖鞋带 复标,然后是 每一评分之内的选票。 表14给出了每一对结果。

blocks.en: Table 14 : Pairwise results of the informal user study ( Tab. 1 ): how often the row setting beat the column setting, ties counting half, with the number of games in parentheses. Shading: green where the row wins more often, red where it loses more often, deeper for a more one-sided result. Constants come first, then schedules, as in Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh: 表14:非正式用户研究的对等结果(表1):行设置比列设置多频度,领带数为一半,括号内为游戏数. 遮蔽:在排胜次数较多的地方是绿色的,在它损失次数较多的地方是红色的,对于更片面的结果更深. 常数先来,然后是时间表,如Tab。 1 (英语).

blocks.en: We also ran Claude Fable 5.1 (Anthropic) as a rater, through an API that gives it the same trials as people: a caption and two of its images on random sides, with the same instruction to pick the image it prefers overall, for how good it looks, how natural it is, and how well it fits the caption, or to call a tie. It cast 2,500 2{,}500 votes, kept apart from the people’s. Table 15 gives its ratings, with the ± \pm over 1,000 1{,}000 bootstrap resamples of its votes. Its ranking agrees with the people’s: the same three settings lead (our constant, our schedule, and TV-CFG, within each other’s intervals), and the other four follow in the same order. It separates the settings more sharply ( 445 445 Elo points from best to worst, against 214 214 for people) and almost never calls a tie ( 18 18 of its 2,500 2{,}500 votes, against 15 % 15\% of the people’s).
blocks.zh: 我们还将Claude Fable 5.1(Anthropic)作为评分器,通过一个API,给予它与人相同的试验:一个标题和两个随机侧面的图像,并有同样的指示来选择它所偏爱的整体图像,因为它看起来多好,多么自然,多么适合标题,或者称之为平局. 它投下了25002{,}500张选票,与人民不同。 表15给出了它的收视率,在 ±\pm 超过 1000 1{,} 000 靴子圈 重新标出它的选票。 它的排名与人民一致:相同的三个设置(我们的常数,我们的日程安排,以及TV-CFG,在彼此的间隔内)领先,其他四个按照相同的顺序排列. 它将环境区分得更明显(445,445 Elo从最佳到最差,214,214对人),几乎从来不称平局(2,500票中的18票,15 % ) 。
